Start with the essentials.
Add more when you need it.

Free includes Apps, Files, Clock, and Weather. Pro is a one-time purchase for content tools, more components, and living backgrounds.

Sill Free
$0
No Sill account needed
Browse and launch installed apps with Apps
Browse local folders you choose with Files
Clock and Weather components
Arrange Free components on your Island
Basic Island appearance, layout, shortcuts, and display placement
Download on App Store
Sill Pro
One-time purchase
More for your Island
Everything in Free. Local pricing in the app.
Unlimited Shelf, Note, Clipboard history, and Translate
Pomodoro, Photo, and Island companion components
Included living backgrounds and custom image backgrounds
Sensitive-content protection and image/PDF text search (OCR)

Try Pro free for 7 days, with no automatic renewal or charge. Purchases and restoration are handled through the App Store. World Landmarks is included with Pro and an active trial; other packs follow their own terms.

See capabilities and requirements
